item.text: I’ll inspect the current grammar and parser changes around trigger damage and Earthbind’s generated test. Then I’ll make the narrowest grammar/parser adjustment that restores the round trip.

The failing string has a trigger with two effects joined by `and`: damage to “that creature” followed by a quoted static ability gain. The refactor made damage require a final period, so it can no longer be the first effect in a chained trigger.

I’m going to preserve the generalized damage rule and only widen its terminator: a damage effect may end with `.` as before, or stop just before `and` when it is followed by another trigger effect. That matches the existing unparser behavior for chained damage effects.
The grammar patch is in. I’ll run the focused generated test first, then format and run the broader gate if the focused failure is fixed.

item.text:
Fixed the Earthbind gate failure in [grammar.pest](/Users/knj/code/github.com/nymann/mtg-parser/crates/mtg-grammar/src/grammar.pest:1407).

The damage refactor required `source_deals_damage` to end with `.`, but Earthbind’s unparsed trigger chains damage into another effect with `and`. I added `trigger_damage_terminator` so the generalized damage rule can terminate either at `.` or just before `and`.

New pest rule rationale: this is a local terminator helper for the already-generalized damage rule, because the existing damage axes could be widened but the rule still needed to distinguish terminal versus chained effects.

Verification passed:

- `cargo fmt --all`
- `cargo test -p mtg-grammar --test generated earthbind::round_trip`
- `cargo test -p mtg-grammar --test generated`
- `cargo test`
